patch.final: \deleted{\unsure{en|et}} remplacer, pour le calcul de $\mathcal E_{X_T}^T$,
patch.evidence: The cancelled word begins with a clear e loop, but the heavy crossing and tall terminal remnant admit en or et; add et without resolving the cancellation. An initial d for de is not supported. The E has open lobes; its X_T index is heavily retraced, but no independent cancellation stroke can be separated from the T crossbar and overtracing. Keep the live T rather than inventing a deleted underlying Y-prime.

doubts_updates.place: cancelled word at the start of main line 16

patch.alternatives: et; cancelled terminal strokes not securely separable

notes_append: Independent audit: fifteen token-different boxes were adjudicated. The cancelled en/et remains uncertain; the additional alternative changes certainty, not the preferred witness-error reading. Formula (15) has no secure added A/a exponent above T. The retraced X_T in the last paragraph has no separately legible erased underletter.
